prompt: Write 10 distinct memories an assistant at Larkmere Mutual keeps about individual members, from what each member said about: moving home mid-policy (theme: Moving house). One or two sentences each, in the third person ("The member…", "They…"), each about a different member. No names. Be concrete and varied: family, work, ages, towns in England and Wales, amounts in pounds, months. This batch leans towards self-employed members and small business owners. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 5)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"The member said they were moving from a rented flat in Leeds to a two-bed terrace in Wakefield in May, and asked to keep the home insurance running on both properties for three weeks because the completion date might slip."},{"type":"fact","content":"They explained that, as a self-employed electrician in Swansea, they had bought a semi-detached house and would be using part of the week to move tools and stock, so they wanted the policy updated from 1 June without any break in cover."},{"type":"fact","content":"The member said they and their partner, both in their early 40s, were upsizing from a small cottage near Chester to a four-bedroom house in Wrexham after the birth of their second child, and asked whether the contents sum insured should increase by about £25,000."},{"type":"fact","content":"They said they run a small bakery in Bristol and were moving home in August to be closer to school runs, but would still store work equipment at the new address; they wanted the insurer to note that the oven and mixers were worth roughly £8,000."},{"type":"fact","content":"The member said they were a taxi driver in Cardiff and had sold their flat while buying a maisonette in Newport, with exchange planned for late September, and they needed confirmation that cover would continue during the move and key handover."},{"type":"fact","content":"They explained that, as a landscaper based in Norwich, they were moving to a larger house with a garage so they could keep tools secure, and they wanted the correspondence address changed immediately while waiting for the final bill from the removals firm."},{"type":"fact","content":"The member said they had just started a small online crafts business from home in Exeter and were moving from a terraced house to a larger property in Plymouth in April, mainly because they needed a spare room for stock, packaging and a desk."},{"type":"fact","content":"They said they were a 58-year-old couple from Shrewsbury relocating to a bungalow in Telford after one of them had knee surgery, and they asked if the unoccupied period between homes, likely 10 days in July, could be covered without extra hassle."},{"type":"fact","content":"The member said they owned a skip hire business in Gloucester and were moving the family from a city flat to a village house in Hereford, with the new place having a detached garage for paperwork and spare parts worth around £12,000."},{"type":"fact","content":"They explained that they were a 29-year-old self-employed photographer moving from a rented apartment in Swansea to a first home in Aberystwyth, and they wanted to know whether accidental damage cover would still apply while furniture and camera kit were being unpacked."}]}
